openDecisions.text: Contract shape for several faces of one family. Revised during implement: an older host (2.7.0, the packs' minimumHandbookVersion) reports an unknown face list and would lose the family, while stylesheets (2.12.0) and resources (2.22.0) already carry extra faces (Mist pattern).
openDecisions.decision: Revised 2026-10-20 (hybrid, no Handbook contract change): assets.fonts keeps one face per family, the static 400 instance; every other weight is an @font-face of a pack stylesheet placed in fonts/ (fonts/faces.css), its files listed in assets.resources. An older host installs the 400 face and synthesises bold. minimumHandbookVersion stays 2.7.0.

openDecisions.text: Which static instances replace each variable font (wght axis only). Measured during implement: Masks, Monster of the Week and The Sprawl publish variable fonts too (Crimson Pro, Josefin Sans, Exo 2, Jura), so schema-pbta#48 covers five packs, not two.
openDecisions.decision: Revised 2026-10-20: for each variable family, one static instance per 100 step of the weight range the pack declares, plus any off-grid weight actually requested (Source Serif 4 750); a family declared at a single weight keeps that single instance and its synthetic bold, as today. Variable files are removed from the packs.

openDecisions.text: Render target: the current rendering, unchanged, of the Adrenaline PJ sheet (07-pretires-2, zombiology vault), the Urban Shadows and Monsterhearts playbooks, in Obsidian and in Lantern; the PDF export carries no Type3 font from a pack. Checkpoints: (1) structure, pdffonts of an A4 export lists no Type3 font from a pack; (2) values, side-by-side captures before/after identical at each weight; (3) finishing, one real print on the HP M426dw completes (IPP job-completed-successfully).
openDecisions.decision: Validated with the routing on 2026-10-20: printing must work, appearance must not change.
